heroSubtitle: We're on a mission to connect people with the best beauty professionals in their neighborhood, making self-care easy and affordable.
missionDescription: To empower everyone to look and feel their best by connecting them with trusted beauty professionals.
visionDescription: A world where quality beauty services are accessible, affordable, and just a tap away.
valuesDescription: Trust, transparency, and community are at the heart of everything we do.
howItStarted1: Henzo was born from a simple question: Why is finding a reliable beauty salon in Vietnam still so difficult in 2024?
howItStarted2: After researching the Vietnamese beauty market, we discovered that talented salon owners lack affordable tools for online booking, while customers waste time calling salons to check availability.
howItStarted3: We're building Henzo to solve this. Currently in development, we're preparing for beta launch with partner salons. Join us on this journey - it's free for beta program.
roadmapSubtitle: We're just getting started - here's our journey from idea to platform
roadmapProblemDescription: Identified the challenge: Vietnamese beauty salons struggle with online booking, while clients can't easily find and compare services.
roadmapMVPDescription: Developed core platform: salon profiles, service listings, online booking system, and review functionality.
roadmapBetaDescription: Launching beta with first partner salons in Da Nang.
roadmapVisionDescription: Scale to 100+ salons, mobile app, loyalty programs, and advanced analytics for salon owners.
valuesSectionSubtitle: Our core values guide every decision we make and shape the Henzo experience
trustSafetyDescription: Every salon is verified and reviewed. We prioritize your safety and satisfaction above all.
customerFirstDescription: Your beauty journey matters to us. We're committed to providing exceptional service every step of the way.
communityDrivenDescription: We build connections between beauty professionals and clients, fostering a supportive community.
innovationDescription: Constantly improving our platform with the latest technology to enhance your experience.
qualityStandardsDescription: We partner only with the best professionals who meet our rigorous quality criteria.
growthTogetherDescription: We succeed when our salons and customers thrive. Your growth is our growth.
ctaSubtitle: Download the Henzo app and get exclusive access to special deals, instant booking, and personalized recommendations.
